verdict.rationale: The docs say an analyst can make a notebook public and share a link with anyone who has a Google account, and paid owners get usage analytics on it. Individual outputs can also be shared: slide decks as PDF, infographics via a share option, and notes exported to Google Docs or Sheets. Viewing a shared research session is clearly delivered, but editing by collaborators is not documented. missing for 10: collaborator edit/contributor roles for building on a shared notebook, private (non-public) sharing with specific people, independent or hands-on corroboration of sharing.
